items.headline: Putin ne nayi parmanu pandubbi Perm dikhayi
items.detail: Severodvinsk me jhanda samaroh me Perm nausena ko saunpi gayi; ye Zircon hypersonic missile wali pehli pandubbi hai, 2030 tak 5 aur aayengi.
items.exam_angle: Perm, Yasen-M, Zircon missile — UPSC IR/Defence

items.headline: Cairo tanker aag me 31 mare, driver giraftar
items.detail: Giza ki Ring Road par tel tanker palatne se aag lagi, 31 mare aur 26 ghayal; police ne 21 saal ke driver ko giraftar kiya.

items.headline: Netanyahu Eisenkot ko pehle PM banne ka offer
items.detail: Khabron ke mutabik Netanyahu, Eisenkot ke saath rotation sarkar me pehle unhe PM banane ko taiyar; Eisenkot ko abhi shak hai, 6 December tak sarkar banana hai.

items.headline: OpenAI ne Apple par chori ka mukadma kiya
items.detail: OpenAI ne California court me Apple par trade secret chori aur suppliers ko dhamkane ka counter-mukadma kiya; July me Apple ne pehle mukadma kiya tha.
items.exam_angle: OpenAI, Apple, trade secrets — UPSC S&T

items.headline: America ne Pacific Archer jahaz ko roka
items.detail: America ne Gulf of Oman me Palau jhande wale Pacific Archer jahaz ko nakabandi todne par roka; jahaz ki propulsion band ki gayi, crew ko koi chot nahi aayi.
items.exam_angle: Iran nakabandi, Hormuz, CENTCOM — UPSC IR

items.headline: Kenya cult neta 123 maut ka doshi
items.detail: Kenya ki adalat ne Shakahola cult ke neta Paul Mackenzie ko 123 anuyayiyon ki maut ka doshi thahraya; woh pehle hi 200 saal ki saza kaat raha hai.
items.exam_angle: Kenya Shakahola cult, Paul Mackenzie — UPSC

items.headline: Brazil ke vitt mantri bane Trabuco
items.detail: Brazil ke rashtrapati Lula ne Bradesco ke adhyaksh Luiz Carlos Trabuco ko agla vitt mantri banaya; ghoshna ke baad real aur share bazaar chadhe.

items.headline: Zelensky: Putin ko dost kehna ajeeb
items.detail: BBC interview me Zelensky ne kaha Trump ka Putin ko 'dost' kehna ajeeb hai, kyunki woh hamlaawar aur hatyara hai; America se Putin par zyada dabav ki maang ki.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine yuddh, Trump-Putin, Zelensky — UPSC IR

items.headline: Cuba ke paas cargo jahaz dooba, 1 mara
items.detail: Panama jhande wala Halima jahaz Cuba ke Cabanas Bay ke paas dooba; 16 me se 13 crew bacha liye gaye, 1 mara aur 3 lapata hain.

items.headline: America Air Force cloud par cyber hamla
items.detail: Hackers ne America Air Force ke Cloud One platform me ghuspaith ki; hamla upgrade ke dauraan pata chala, data chori hui ya nahi abhi pata nahi.
items.exam_angle: Cloud One, cyber hamla, US Air Force — UPSC

items.headline: Kuwait drone hamle me 2 Italian mare
items.detail: Kuwait me drone hamle ke baad gire malbe se 2 Italian technician mare; Kuwait aur Italy ne Iran par ilzam lagaya, Iran ne inkar kiya.
items.exam_angle: Kuwait, Iran, drone hamla — UPSC IR

items.headline: New Zealand chunav: kisi ko bahumat nahi
items.detail: New Zealand ke antim natijon me satta-dhari gathbandhan ko 130 me se 65 seatein mili, bahumat se 1 kam; Opportunity Party ab nirnayak hai.
items.exam_angle: New Zealand chunav, hung parliament — UPSC IR
